payload.summary: Resolved the final lifecycle, resume, and delivery-override blockers without changing the persisted ESCALATE state. The plan now uses controller-bound leases, stored durability targets, collision-safe process evidence, external autopilot run state, ambiguous-only RFC-8785-bound overrides, and smaller executable work packages.
completed_work: Resolved all seven critical findings from the third plan review and both high testability/determinism findings.
Added schema-enforced controller, durability, recovery, ambiguous-override, and selected-stage invariants.
Split registry, phase, delivery, and autopilot work into focused test-first tasks and added executable ancestry, formatting, hook, and regression gates.
Validated strict OpenSpec, package DAG/scope, schema metaschemas, representative negative/positive instances, and diff whitespace.

decisions.title: Bind automatic ownership to the controller
decisions.rationale: Owner and lease identity alone cannot exclude a duplicate live resume; every automatic mutation now requires the exact owner, lease, and controller triple.

decisions.title: Persist durability and recovery identity
decisions.rationale: Takeover and disposal must use an entry-owned remote/ref and retain former process evidence until termination is proven.

decisions.title: Keep resumable autopilot state outside disposable checkouts
decisions.rationale: ESCALATE and exception teardown must remain resumable after the worktree and registry entry are removed.

decisions.title: Permit delivery overrides only for ambiguous evidence
decisions.rationale: A clear implementation classification must never be downgraded to proposal through operator disposition.

next_steps: Run a fresh independent plan review against plan revision 4.
Only after review convergence, satisfy baseline-gates.json and begin package implementation.

relevant_files.description: Revision 4 package DAG and executable gates
